    Learn more
    View full details

    Arrow Hit 2026 Pro-Edt: Power and Control Guaranteed

    The Adidas Arrow Hit 2026 Pro-Edt is a Racket that takes the game to another level, designed to offer professional performance in every hit. It combines power, control, and top-quality materials. It is the official Racket of the talented Catalan player Ari Sánchez. Its diamond shape and balanced weight allow for explosive shots without sacrificing stability in quick actions near the net. The ASC Signature Carbon surface provides stiffness and precision, while the Eva Soft Performance core ensures a comfortable feel and excellent vibration absorption. This Racket is designed to balance aggressiveness and manageability, with technologies that enhance strength, spin, and structural durability.

    Arrow Hit 2026 Pro-Edt: For Advanced Players

    Aimed at professional or advanced level players who train and compete regularly, this Racket is ideal for those seeking power with a centered sweet spot, allowing for powerful smashes without losing control in transition shots. Its balanced weight favors an aggressive yet stable game, fitting perfectly with offensive players who need precision in volleys, overheads, and smashes, as well as comfort in defense thanks to the soft feel of the core.

    Highlighted Technologies

    • Muscle Power System to increase power in every hit.
    • Power Groove to enhance stiffness and energy transmission.
    • Extra Power Grip to increase leverage and thus force when hitting the ball more violently.
    • 3D Spin Blade to generate advanced spin in every contact with the Racket.
    • Smart Holes Curve to optimize control and aerodynamics.
    • Structural Reinforcement for greater durability.
    • Intelligent Balance System to customize the balance of the Racket.
    • Optimized weight between 360 - 375 gr.
    • Eva Soft Performance core for a more comfortable feel.
    • Carbon Fiber Surface.

    The Arrow Hit 2026 Pro-Edt, available at Street Padel

    The Adidas Arrow Hit 2026 Pro-Edt is a complete, powerful, and technically advanced Racket, perfect for players seeking professional performance and a solid construction that responds at every point.

    WE ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS

    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

    Are the products genuine and officially licensed by the brand?

    Yes. All the products we sell are 100% genuine and official, sourced directly from the manufacturers and their authorised distributors. We guarantee the authenticity of every item.

    Can I return the product if I’m not satisfied with it?

    Yes. You have up to 30 days to return the product, provided it is in perfect condition and retains its original packaging. See the full terms in our Shipping and Returns section.

    What warranty do the products come with?

    All our products come with the official warranty provided by each brand. You can find all the details in our Shipping and Returns section.
